description: This file contains an abstract class 'StreamingCacheMissTests' that defines unit tests for Orleans streaming cache behavior, including scenarios for cache eviction, filtered events, and interactions with cache memory management. It sets up test methods to verify that events are correctly delivered or ignored based on cache state and filtering logic.

classes.name: StreamingCacheMissTests
classes.description: An abstract test class for verifying Orleans stream cache eviction, filtering, and cache management behavior.

classes.name: CustomStreamFilter
classes.description: A nested class implementing IStreamFilter to filter stream messages based on their byte content.

methods.name: PreviousEventEvictedFromCacheTest
methods.description: Tests that messages are correctly delivered even after eviction from cache, including cache expiration wait time and delivery verification.

methods.name: PreviousEventEvictedFromCacheWithFilterTest
methods.description: Verifies that cache eviction is unaffected by filtered events, ensuring filtered messages don't interfere with cache management and non-filtered messages are properly delivered afterward.
